reuse.why: The change extends existing recurrence and weekend helpers and shares holiday exclusions, but the range handler adds its own daily-frequency dispatch.

duplication.why: The range handler repeats the upcoming-date occurrence-to-adjusted-day pipeline and independently decides the daily-versus-moving policy.

placement.why: Most policy remains in shared/schedules.ts, although the range handler embeds frequency and adjustment-window policy in the server layer.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested scheduling changes, their consumers, tests, types, and release notes.

maintainability.why: Shared helpers provide a useful foundation, but separate holiday representations, an arbitrary expansion horizon, and caller-owned adjustment margins create maintenance coupling.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getDatesInRange conditionally bypasses applyWeekendRule based on frequency, independently encoding policy already handled by recurConfigToRSchedule and getHolidayExdates.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange reshapes getUpcomingDates' occurrence-to-adjusted-day mapping into a loop while adding a local daily-frequency branch.

abstraction_drift.where: Holiday parameters are added to applyWeekendRule, applyWeekendRuleToDay, and getDateWithSkippedWeekend; shared policy gains daily-weekend filtering, daily-only holiday exclusions, and annual-holiday expansion, while getDatesInRange bypasses adjustment for daily schedules.
